title: mouriri myrtilloides subsp. parvifolia
intro: Mouriri myrtilloides subsp. parvifolia, commonly known as Mouriri, is a species of flowering plant in the family Melastomataceae. Mouriri is a plant that offers various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Mouriri include wound healing, anti-arthritic, and antidiarrheal effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Mouriri myrtilloides subsp. parvifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
